scenario_description:
Objective: Make the overnight airport-hotel departure calmer while the confirmed stay, shuttle, and flight remain usable without any extra arrangement.
Emerging Need: Optional mobile-key room placement becomes worthwhile only after the early shuttle, carried roller, hotel reservation, and room-preference board align.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on combining the hotel notice with stored room-side request rules, the active reservation, and the shuttle evidence.
Consequence: Timely use would shorten the morning lobby traverse and reduce hassle; missing the board simply leaves ordinary room assignment and standard checkout in place.

parameter.title: ORD-to-Detroit sponsor demo flight
parameter.description: Lakeshore Air morning departure from O'Hare for the Detroit sponsor demo; arrive with personal travel documents and field credentials.
parameter.location: Chicago O'Hare Terminal 2 to Detroit Metro

parameter.subject: O'Hare North Tower reservation CHI-NORTH-7712 confirmed
parameter.body: Your one-night reservation for Tuesday, November 17 is confirmed under CHI-NORTH-7712. Standard room assignment is guaranteed at arrival if no mobile preference is entered. Check-in begins at 15:00; mobile-key options, when available, appear the day before arrival.

parameter.description: Guest shuttle seat for 2026-11-18 04:45 north-lobby departure to ORD Terminal 2

parameter.content: For Wednesday morning, please bring the black field-laptop roller and your current FTA credential. We only need the compact demo loadout, so no team crates or robot parts are expected.

parameter.subject: Mobile-key room-preference board open for CHI-NORTH-7712
parameter.body: The room-preference board for November 17 arrivals is open until 18:00 today. Guests may list elevator-bank or tower-side preferences for mobile-key assignment; otherwise a standard room will be assigned at the front desk on arrival.

parameter.subject: Room-preference board exported for November 17 arrivals
parameter.body: The November 17 mobile-key preference board exported at 18:00. New tower-side or elevator-bank entries are no longer being added; remaining guests will receive standard room assignment at arrival.
